messages.subject: Re: Problems
parts:
okay.

I use an Ubuntu Linux 9.0 How do I install Red R

Ajay Ohri

www.decisionstats.com

Also can you upload the .avi video to You Tube so I can view and if possible embed it.

I have interviewed the creators of R Commander John Fox, of Interface to R ( Paul), and Rattle ( Graham Williams), Revolution R ( CEO Richard and COO David Smith)  and SAS Institute (John Sall) on my blog

www.decisionstats.com

Would anyone guide me to the development team of Red R so I can

1) First view the You Tube Video

2) Test it on an Linux or an Windows if they dont have Linux version yet

3) if the above is okay take an interview for my blog

4) If above is okay write a paper on Interface to R at www.jstatsoft.com  ;) ( you may want to do the item 4 by yourself )

More Force to you

messages.subject: Re: Problems
parts:
We don't yet have an installer for the Linux system but are working to
develop one.

You may get a copy of the installer at: http://code.google.com/p/r-orange/downloads/list

The YouTube demo is a good idea and I'll look into it.

Thanks
